topic: Database view creation and deployment process
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on the technical steps for deploying a database change. [p1] received approval to proceed with the deployment and committed the necessary SQL code.

[me] advised that while the view re-creation is quick, it would temporarily cause data loss from dashboards and prevent new records from being accessed during the process, though this was deemed non-critical.

Following successful execution of the change, the discussion shifted to unrelated geopolitical topics regarding immigration limits in Israel.
decisions: The database view was successfully re-created and deployed.
